facets.label: Desktop OS
facets.description: A shipped desktop client on this operating system. Experimental builds must retain their receipt scope.

facets.label: Web client
facets.description: A released browser interface for working with the ADE.

facets.label: Phone access
facets.description: Native phone apps and a phone browser are separate options. A relay alone does not prove a client.

facets.label: CLI
facets.description: A product-owned command-line interface, distinct from an underlying coding agent CLI.

facets.label: Coding agents
facets.description: Named coding harnesses the ADE can run. Model-provider choice alone does not establish harness support.

facets.label: Use my subscription
facets.description: Use an existing coding-agent subscription through its supported native login. API-key support alone is insufficient.

facets.label: Where agents run
facets.description: Where agent work executes, distinct from where its client or control plane runs. On your computer: the machine you are using. On your own server: a machine or cloud account you control, such as a VPS, home server or your own cloud. In the vendor's cloud: machines the ADE vendor operates. Whether work survives a closed laptop is the separate laptop-closed filter.

facets.label: Workspace isolation
facets.description: An explicitly documented isolation option. A worktree separates files and is not a security sandbox.

facets.label: Parallel runs
facets.description: More than one agent session can work concurrently.

facets.label: Coordinator
facets.description: A product-owned agent can delegate work to other agents and inspect or communicate with them.

facets.label: Native issue tracking
facets.description: Persistent product-owned issues or tasks with state, distinct from a chat/session list or external tracker link.

facets.label: Unattended triggers
facets.description: A schedule or external event can start work without a human initiating each run.

facets.label: Shared prompting
facets.description: Multiple human users can send instructions to the same agent work. Shared read-only links are insufficient.

facets.label: Team roles
facets.description: Named workspace or organization roles with documented permissions.

facets.label: SSO
facets.description: Enterprise or team single sign-on is explicitly documented. Preserve plan restrictions in the receipt.

facets.label: Pull request workflow
facets.description: The ADE can create or manage pull requests as part of its workflow.

facets.label: Review interface
facets.description: A product interface displays proposed code changes or diffs for review.

facets.label: Product license
facets.description: License covering the main application. A licensed SDK or public release repository alone is insufficient. GPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0 represent version 3, including explicit version-3-only findings; use an or-later option only when that grant is established. Component and hosted-service exceptions stay in the receipt scope.

facets.label: Self-hosting
facets.description: The core ADE can run on user-controlled infrastructure. Self-managed execution workers alone are insufficient.

facets.label: Telemetry opt-out
facets.description: A documented control disables the ADE telemetry. A privacy policy alone is insufficient.

facets.label: Free access
facets.description: The ADE offers a recurring free plan or a free application download. Trial credits alone are insufficient. Agent and compute costs can remain separate.

facets.label: Starting price
facets.description: Lowest recurring public USD monthly ADE price, excluding agent/model and own-compute costs. No currency conversion or annual-price extrapolation.

facets.label: Pricing model
facets.description: How the ADE itself charges, from its public pricing, terms or licence. Free, no paid plan: the whole ADE is free of charge and the checked first-party sources show no paid tier, including open-source software. Free plan: a recurring free plan or free download sits beside paid plans. Subscription: a recurring individual or flat plan fee. Per seat: team pricing charged per user. Usage-based: tokens, credits or runtime billed by consumption. Per machine or compute: charges for machines, sandboxes, VMs, hosts or compute hours. Bring your own key: your own model provider key pays for model use. One-time purchase: a one-off licence fee. A product can have several. No needs an explicit restriction; model plans sold separately from the ADE do not count.

facets.label: Paid plans from
facets.description: Lowest public paid ADE plan price in USD per month at monthly billing, per user when seat-priced, excluding agent/model and own-compute costs. A price between two brackets belongs to the higher one. Contact sales means paid plans exist without a public price. No currency conversion, annual-price extrapolation or one-time purchases.

facets.label: Lifecycle status
facets.description: A published shutdown or acquisition notice, with service scope and dates.

facets.label: Keeps going with laptop closed
facets.description: Work continues on a remote machine, yours or the vendor's, after the laptop you control it from sleeps or disconnects. Closing a client on the same host is insufficient.
